scope: Live anatomy close-ups with pose-aware framing and preserved observation context

initialBrowserRun.finding: Overhead framing made the folded owl wing too narrow; the grounded-wing starting view was changed to the side.

combinedBrowserRun.command: npx playwright test tests/e2e/raptor-study-anatomy.spec.ts tests/e2e/raptor-study-mode.spec.ts tests/e2e/raptor-study-observations.spec.ts tests/e2e/raptor-study-report.spec.ts --project=chromium --workers=1 --retries=0 --reporter=list --output=reports/raptor-3d-anatomy-2026-09-27/final-browser-results
combinedBrowserRun.failure: The owl/fullscreen scenario exceeded its 180-second total limit. Trace showed its assertions succeeding near the limit; the following serial test did not run.

targetedBrowserRun.command: npx playwright test tests/e2e/raptor-study-anatomy.spec.ts --grep 'folded owl|inspection context' --project=chromium --workers=1 --retries=0 --reporter=list --output=reports/raptor-3d-anatomy-2026-09-27/targeted-browser-results
targetedBrowserRun.testAllowanceChange: Only the longer owl scenario uses a 300-second total limit. Action and assertion limits remain unchanged.
